title: RNA-seq Nextflow Pipeline Parameters
description: Parameters for a containerised paired-end bulk RNA-seq workflow covering QC, trimming, alignment, quantification, DESeq2 and MultiQC.

samplesheet.description: CSV file with columns sample_id, fastq_1, fastq_2 and condition.

genome_index.description: HISAT2 genome index prefix, excluding the .1.ht2/.2.ht2 suffix.

gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF used by featureCounts.

outdir.description: Directory or object-store URI for published results.

ref_condition.description: Reference condition used in the DESeq2 contrast.

aws_queue.description: AWS Batch queue name used by the awsbatch profile.

aws_region.description: AWS region used by the awsbatch profile.

aws_workdir.description: S3 work directory used by the awsbatch profile, for example s3://bucket/work.
